label: P5A2-BRANCH-IABT-MERGE
documentation_tip: final documentation commit tip is the branch HEAD reported in the handoff; source_sha/head_sha bind the RTL implementation
scope: 修复 FIFO-on/legacy fetch fault outcome 晚于 older MEM/WB 提交时无法合并 IABT 的年龄与 settled 时序；保持 current-epoch quarantine、提交顺序、系统/ERET merge、维护 owner 与普通分支语义。

implementation.summary: 新增 memwb_fetch_target_settled/memwb_fetch_wait。FIFO-on 以同代 FIFO entry 或 matching fetch fault 为 settled，已交付到 IF/ID、ID/EX、EX/MEM 的 target 也视为 settled；legacy path 仅对匹配的在途 fetch context 等待实际 IMEM 数据/fault。memwb_fetch_wait 并入 stall_wb，保持 MEM/WB、EX/MEM、FIFO pop，禁止 commit_fire 提前退休；younger system redirect、maintenance request/response owner、TLBI 和维护状态机在该等待期间遵循年龄边界。新增 maint_imem_req_selected 与 accepted-but-not-consumed 的 maint_imem_rsp_pending metadata，延迟/缓存响应跨 flush 仍排空到 maintenance，不误送普通 fetch；legacy MMU fetch acceptance 同步锁存 fetch_pc_r。

root_cause.mechanism: fetch_walk 只冻结流水级更新而不冻结 commit_fire。BR 进入 MEM/WB 后，目标 0x50000000 的 MMU walk 尚未完成时仍正常提交；稍后 mmu_done/fetch_faulted 到达，matching fault 只能进入 FIFO，已无可合并的未提交 MEM/WB entry。
root_cause.age_boundary: 在途目标结果未 settled 时，memwb_fetch_wait=1 -> stall_wb=1、commit_fire=0；目标 fault 被锁存后下一提交边界满足 fetch_merge_wb，保留 older 指令写回并转为 IABT。

preserved: 公共 commit packet 与 memory ABI 未修改
current-epoch FIFO push、stale response quarantine 与 fault-head 不消费规则未放宽
无断言关闭、无跳过差分、无参考结果修改

owner_metadata.wait_boundary: memwb_fetch_wait blocks maintenance IMEM/DCZVA/TLBI side effects; MS_WAIT may only drain an already accepted response
